title: Kenyan Wrap with Earthy Flavors
description: Experience the unique flavors of Kenya with this earthy wrap filled with nutty cobnuts and a hint of Kenyan spices.

ingredients.name: kenyan spices
ingredients.notes: mix of cumin, coriander, and turmeric

instructions: Preheat a pan or griddle to medium heat.
Brush the wrap with olive oil and cook for 1-2 minutes on each side.
In a separate pan, heat a little oil and cook the sliced mushrooms until they're tender.
Add the chopped cobnuts and nutty mixture to the pan with the mushrooms and cook for another minute.
Add the Kenyan spices and cook for 30 seconds.
Assemble the wrap by spreading the mushroom and cobnut mixture on the cooked wrap.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
